purpose: Provide executable committed-sample metrics, AtGrid termination, terminal observation and compact result semantics for the current YYZ trajectory.

provenance.notes: The repository owner accepted the recommended fixture-local inclusive AtGrid, priority and terminal-observation choices. This bundle is read-only and does not introduce product runtime contracts.

expected_facts.claim: Independent Decimal and C++17 implementations derive duration, downrange, mass and speed metrics exclusively from contiguous committed samples.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Identity, tick and sample visibility are exact; derived numeric values use the declared absolute-plus-relative tolerance.

expected_facts.claim: Inclusive AtGrid any-of predicates select higher priority at simultaneous triggers, map Complete and Abort to distinct final statuses, and stop at the first terminal committed boundary.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Predicate, priority, action, status and boundary identities are exact.

expected_facts.claim: The terminal committed sample and structured decision are sealed before the result freezes, and no post-terminal sample contributes to metrics or decisions.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Terminal event order, seal state and post-terminal count are exact.

acceptance: The bundle evaluates both complete and abort paths from committed samples and preserves the first terminal boundary
The Decimal reference and C++17 probe share no implementation and neither imports product or Legacy code
Canonical thresholds, continuous location, lifecycle, durability and public contracts remain outside this slice
